body:
This would be interesting, but require an other request per value (it can't even be done in a single request, since you don't know which values are available until the request has returned), and therefore something we have chosen not to implement. Visually  it makes a lot of sense, but we have not found a way to know exhaustively which values are available. This problem becomes more clear once you consider lists of > 100 facet values, while the engine has a limit of 100 values retrieved per facet.

If however while experimenting, you find out a way that doesn't require a request per facet value, we'd of course love to look at that
